question: In Table 1, which company is running the NBF-006 trial, and what is its status?

trace.query: SELECT c.id, c.row_no, c.col_no, c.text FROM cells c WHERE c.table_id='p2.T1' AND c.row_no IN (SELECT row_no FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND text ILIKE '%NBF-006%') ORDER BY c.row_no, c.col_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%NBF-006%' OR text ILIKE '%NBF%'
